ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory CDD/EDD screening of all directors, shareholders, beneficial owners and authorized signatories against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, United Kingdom Sanctions List, Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit domestic lists and publicly available politically exposed persons (PEP) databases. Enhanced due diligence is required for any PEP, family member or close associate. The registered agent must verify the full ownership chain above the 25% beneficial ownership threshold, identify source of funds, and maintain records for at least five years after termination of the business relationship. Continuous ongoing screening is required during the life of the International Company.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa International Companies Registry (International Companies Office, under the Samoa International Finance Authority)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be in English or Samoan and displayed in Latin script. Any non-Latin script name, including a Chinese name, may only be used as an auxiliary or transliterated name and must be rendered into an approved Latin-script transliteration for registration. A transliteration certificate from a recognized translation authority or notary is required where the proposed name originate from a non-Latin script. The registered name must end with a corporate designation confirming limited liability, ordinarily 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Corporation', 'Corp', 'Incorporated', 'Inc' or the Samoan equivalent.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name reservation may be extended by a written application filed with the Registrar of International Companies before the expiration of the initial 30-day window. If a proposed name is rejected, the applicant must submit a formal written appeal to the Registrar within 14 days of the rejection notice, stating the legal basis for the request, showing that the name is not deceptive, prohibited, misleading or contrary to public interest, and providing one or more alternative proposed names. The appeal may escalate to the Samoa International Finance Authority and ultimately to the Minister of Commerce, Industry and Labour for administrative review; final decisions may be challenged by judicial review in the Supreme Court of Samoa.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A fully remote or virtual office is permissible for this offshore International Company provided that a licensed registered agent maintains a registered office and registered agent address in Samoa. The virtual office arrangement may not be used for conducting regulated financial services or holding client funds within Samoa. The registered agent will host the statutory records, corporate registers and AML/CFT documentation. Commercial substance may be demonstrated by board minutes, written resolutions, share registers, financial records and outsourcing contracts kept at the registered agent's office.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low, quantified at approximately 2% annual probability for a compliant non-resident PE buyout SPV with no local trading presence. The probability may rise to between 8% and 12% if there are anomalous fund movements, a suspicious transaction report, adverse media, sanction list matches or irregular beneficial ownership layers. Unannounced on-site inspections by the Registrar of International Companies or the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit are legally permitted upon reasonable suspicion.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (as amended), ss. 10-15; International Companies (Amendment) Act 2007
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Financial Authority (SIFA)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Incorporation of an International Company and Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital requirement; authorised capital may be denominated in any currency; no escrow account mandated
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the Company subscribes for one ordinary share of no par value at US$1.00 consideration, and the share is issued to the sole subscriber as recorded in the register of members. RESOLVED that the registered office of the Company be established at [address] in Samoa, and the Registered Agent is authorised to maintain custody of the statutory records. RESOLVED that [Name] be appointed Secretary and [Name] be appointed Director of the Company, with full authority to execute banking documents, engage professional advisers, and file all requisite returns with the Registrar of International Companies and SIFA. All actions taken prior to this resolution are hereby ratified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Samoa International Financial Authority (SIFA), Registrar of International Companies
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a written name reservation request to SIFA specifying the proposed name, corporate type 'International Company', and a statement of no conflict with existing registered names. The application may be filed electronically or by courier. Upon approval, the name is reserved for a period of 30 days.
required_dossiers: Written consent from proposed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected as undesirable or confusingly similar, the applicant may submit a new name or appeal in writing to the Registrar of International Companies within 14 days of the refusal notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public in Samoa or foreign notary recognised under the International Companies Act
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in English, including objects clause, permitted share capital, and adoption of the full English-language governing law clause. Execute the documents by the subscriber and have the signature notarised. If executed abroad, provide a notarised true copy with apostille or legalisation as required under Samoa law.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association (signed and notarised)
Consent to act as first director and secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If notarisation is challenged, cure by obtaining a fresh notarial attestation or by continuing the execution in Samoa before a local notary public.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Application with SIFA
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Financial Authority (SIFA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the application for incorporation together with the executed Memorandum and Articles, registered agent consent, and government fee. The application must state the intention to conduct business as an International Company and include the registered office address in Samoa. Payment of the filing fee is made by wire transfer or authorised bank draft.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association (as filed)
Government filing fee proof of payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a requisition, the applicant has 30 days to respond in writing with corrected documents or further evidence; failure to cure within the period may result in withdrawal of the application, with the applicant entitled to refile.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Commencement of Legal Existence
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Financial Authority (SIFA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon review and approval, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation dated and signed. The company's legal existence commences from that date. Verify the certificate details and obtain certified copies for the company records, bank account opening, and external counsel.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of Memorandum and Articles
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any clerical error in the Certificate may be corrected by filing a written rectification request with supporting evidence; the Registrar is empowered to issue an amended certificate without the need for re-incorporation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appointment of Officers and Adoption of First Board Resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the International Company
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convening the first board meeting or passing a written resolution, the subscribers shall appoint the first director and secretary, adopt the registered office and registered agent, and authorise the opening of bank accounts and execution of private equity subscription agreements. File any required notice of appointment of officers with the Registrar.
required_dossiers: Minutes of first board meeting or written resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar rejects the officer appointment filing, submit corrected identification or consent documents within 21 days; non-compliance may render the company liable to restoration fees but does not invalidate acts done before rejection.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: N/A – no physical premises, employees, or occupational workplace established in Samoa; no fire safety certificate or structural load inspection is required

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry for Revenue of the Independent State of Samoa (formerly Samoa Tax Administration); taxpayer portal: https://www.revenue.gov.ws; customs matters co-administered by the Samoa Customs Service under the Ministry for Revenue.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: An International Company (IC) incorporated under the International Companies Act 1987 is automatically ring-fenced and tax-exempt; no domestic TIN is required for offshore business. A TIN is obtained from the Ministry for Revenue only where the IC voluntarily registers for VAGST (annual turnover threshold WST 30,000), appoints resident employees (PAYE), or holds Samoan-source assets. Procedure: submit a completed IR-01 taxpayer registration/company form, certified copy of the IC certificate of incorporation and charter, registered-office consent, and director/secretary particulars; the Ministry issues the TIN/VAGST registration within five working days. The offshore exemption is not conditioned on obtaining a TIN.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch elective classification exists under Samoan law. The IC automatically receives ring-fenced offshore exemption under the International Companies Act 1987, s. 132 (no income tax, capital gains tax, estate or gift tax, stamp duty, or exchange-control obligations). The only available election is voluntary VAGST registration under the Goods and Services Tax Act 2003 for domestic-source supplies, which does not impair the IC's income-tax exemption.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAGST (Value Added Goods and Services Tax) – Samoa's national value-added tax administered under the Goods and Services Tax Act 2003
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Compulsory registration where annual taxable turnover exceeds WST 30,000, or where taxable supplies are made through a registered branch in Samoa; voluntary registration is available for smaller suppliers. International Companies carrying on exclusively offshore activities are not required to register and are outside the VAGST net.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, e-invoicing API, or digital stamping regime is in force. Registered suppliers must issue serially-numbered tax invoices showing supplier and recipient names, TINs, description, VAGST-exclusive amount, VAGST amount, and date; export invoices must include the export entry reference. All invoices and underlying records must be retained for the statutory record-keeping period under the Tax Administration Act 2015.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A zero rate applies to goods physically exported from Samoa within 30 days of supply (direct exports) and to offshore services supplied to non-residents, including fund-management, buyout, advisory, and syndication services rendered by a private-equity SPV to non-Samoan funds and investors. The IC's offshore equity-buyout activities are outside the scope of VAGST. Where the IC is VAGST-registered, input VAGST on Samoan-sourced acquisition costs (e.g., legal and registered-office fees) is refundable through the standard refund mechanism upon production of export/offshore-supply evidence and filing of a nil or credit return.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (CusDec) electronically lodged and cleared by the Samoa Customs Service
Bill of Lading, Sea Waybill, or Air Waybill evidencing physical exportation
Commercial invoice and the underlying acquisition/sale agreement for the buyout transaction
VAGST tax invoice and export invoice issued by the IC (if VAGST-registered)
Inward remittance certificate or SWIFT MT103 evidencing payment by the non-resident buyer
Insurance certificate and, where required, certificate of origin
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Ministry for Revenue may reassess and claw back any VAGST refund or zero-rated treatment where export documentation or the inward remittance is absent. Deliberate fraudulent zero-rating attracts a shortfall penalty of up to 100% (aggravated for concealment), late-payment interest, and criminal sanctions for wilful evasion, including fines up to WST 100,000 and imprisonment; directors and the licensed resident agent may be jointly and severally liable. Repatriation of export proceeds must be evidenced within 180 days of export; otherwise the zero-rating is reversed and the resulting tax and penalties are immediately recoverable.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (Faletupe Tutotonu o Samoa), acting through its Exchange Control Division under the Exchange Control Act 1976 and the Exchange Control Regulations 1977; licensed commercial banks operate as authorized foreign exchange dealers.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan Tala (WST) is convertible for current-account transactions under a CBS-managed float; resident capital-account outflows require exchange-control approval through authorized dealers. A Samoa International Company is statutorily treated as non-resident and exempted from exchange-control restrictions on transactions settled entirely in foreign currency, so capital injection, profit remittance, and dividend distributions face no CBS approval hurdle. The only practical constraint on profit remittance is correspondent-bank availability and completion of the bank's outward-remittance form when WST conversion is needed; no tax-clearance certificate is required because the IC holds a statutory income-tax exemption under the International Companies Act 1987.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Resident exporters must repatriate proceeds within 180 days of shipment and credit or surrender them to an authorized dealer in WST. International Companies are expressly carved out: foreign-currency receipts are exempt from any surrender or conversion obligation, and the CBS grants a standing exemption upon application by the licensed registered agent. The PE SPV will denominate all contributions, loans, and target payables in USD, thereby never triggering the surrender rule.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: USD Capital Escrow Account with multi-currency operational sub-ledgers
USD Operational Account with segregated loan-drawdown sub-accounts

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium viability. Major electronic money institutions and payment fintechs routinely decline Samoan International Companies because their correspondent-risk matrices classify the jurisdiction as an offshore financial center with elevated velocity risk. Where an offshore EMI (Wise, Airwallex, Currencycloud) does accept a Samoa IC, it demands the licensed registered-agent confirmation, fund-level financials or administrator confirmation, and perpetual beneficial-ownership disclosure; the EMI cannot access WST domestic clearing because the Central Bank of Samoa has not licensed any local EMI. The EMI rail is strictly auxiliary for this SPV: small professional-fee payments only, never syndicated-loan proceeds or acquisition escrow.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical attendance in Samoa is not required. Foreign directors may onboard fully remotely via notarized certified passport copies, a live video-verified KYC interview with the bank's relationship manager, a physical confirmation certificate issued by the licensed Samoa registered agent, and a bank-to-bank reference from the upstream fund's principal bank. The banks retain discretion to summon one natural-person director or the general partner's senior officer to an in-person meeting in Apia when enhanced due diligence identifies discrete source-of-funds or sanctions concerns.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Multi-tier offshore ownership chain (Cayman feeder and Delaware LP above the Samoa IC) obscuring the ultimate beneficial owner
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full ownership org chart from natural-person UBOs to the SPV; certified charter documents of each intermediate vehicle; register of directors and members of the Samoa IC endorsed by the registered agent; registered-agent letter confirming identity of natural persons.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-exempt offshore status perceived as tax-evasion or substance-less flag-of-convenience arrangement
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed limited partnership agreement and investment mandate; audited fund statements or latest NAV report; transaction flowchart mapping capital to identified buyout targets; Samoa counsel legal opinion confirming lawful tax-exempt use and compliance with applicable economic substance requirements; CRS/FATCA registration confirmations for the fund and the IC.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque source of funds for the equity injection and syndicated loan drawdowns
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Twelve months of originating account statements; executed equity subscription and shareholder loan agreements; capital-call and distribution notices from the fund administrator; signed representation that the funds are not third-party financed or courier-delivered.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Presumption of bearer shares or bearer instruments in legacy offshore vehicles
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registered-agent statutory declaration confirming that all issued shares are either registered shares or bearer shares immobilized with the licensed agent; current register of members; certificate of good standing from the Samoa International Companies Registry; cancellation or custody certificates for any bearer instruments.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions and politically exposed person screening hits on limited partners or target-company jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Completed fund sanctions questionnaire listing all named beneficial investors; Refinitiv or World-Check screening output; sworn statement that no sanctioned entity or individual holds an interest; independent legal opinion on the acquisition-target jurisdictions.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Equity contributions and shareholder loans are wired from the upstream fund's money-center bank to the Samoa IC's USD account at ANZ/BSP Samoa via SWIFT MT103, or MT202 COV where the syndicate settles through a nostro relationship. The payment narrative must read 'equity contribution to Samoa International Company' or 'shareholder loan drawdown' with the beneficiary exactly matching the onboarded USD account line; the dealer records the CBS balance-of-payments purpose classification ('direct investment equity' or 'other investment: loans') for central reporting. Verification steps include matching the remitter to the subscribed investor register, passing the IC board resolution allotting shares or approving the loan, and preserving the capital-call audit trail from the general partner.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Acquisition consideration and fees settle via SWIFT MT103 for direct payments to sellers and advisors, MT202 COV for cover payments routed through the escrow bank, and commercial letters of credit under UCP600 issued by the Samoan dealer's trade desk for deferred consideration. As borrower under the syndicated facility, the SPV receives the facility agent's MT202 into a designated USD loan account and on-lends to the target through a term-loan agreement disbursed by MT103 into seller's escrow. Wires above USD 500,000 must be pre-notified with an executed disbursement schedule so payments flow without friction through the dealers' single-channel correspondents.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable USD/WST forward contracts with ANZ Bank Samoa or BSP Samoa covering WST-denominated operating and regulatory fees
Offshore nondeliverable USD/WST forward structured by an OECD-bank branch and settled in USD against the Central Bank of Samoa mid-rate
Cross-currency swap booked under an ISDA master agreement with an OECD counterparty, converting USD floating-rate (SOFR) acquisition debt into the target company's operating currency
FX swap with principal exchange for temporary conversion of USD cash into WST working capital
Currency collar on residual passive currency exposure arising from deferred purchase consideration

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government License Fee Renewal - International Company (standard authorized capital up to USD 1,000,000)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) - Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary of incorporation; annual renewal must be completed by the company's anniversary date each year, subject to a customary 60-day administrative grace period.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal penalty is assessed once the grace period expires; continued non-payment triggers a notice of default, administrative strike-off, dissolution of the company, and monetary fines against directors and officers.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Confirmation Statement (non-public filing to registered agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: SIFA via the licensed Samoa registered agent; beneficial ownership register maintained at the registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due at the same time as the annual renewal, i.e., on the anniversary of incorporation; immediate notification is also required upon any change in shareholders or ultimate beneficial owners.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance with beneficial ownership confirmation exposes the company and its officers to information notices, monetary penalties, criminal sanctions in persistent cases, and the power of SIFA to initiate administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Office and Registered Agent Availability Attestation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual renewal date; the registered agent must attest the continued availability of the registered office and the agent's consent to continue acting.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain a registered office and registered agent in Samoa is a statutory contravention; the Registrar may strike off the company after notice.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Accounting Record Location Notice or Record Retention Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: SIFA / registered agent (records may remain external to Samoa if the location is advised)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually at renewal; the company must be able to state where accounting records are physically kept when SIFA requests.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to retain or produce accounting records is a criminal offense under Samoa law and may result in officer penalties and, in aggravated cases, compulsory audit or strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory independent audit is imposed on an ordinary exempted Samoa International Company merely by reason of size, turnover, or balance sheet total. A compulsory audit arises only where the International Company holds a SIFA-regulated license (bank, insurance, trust, or other licensed financial activity) or where SIFA imposes an audit condition under a specific direction. A private equity buyout SPV engaged in principal holding and syndicated borrowing is not compulsorily audited solely by virtue of its ISIC 6499 activity.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as issued by the IASB is the recognized standard for voluntary statutory-format financial statements; Samoa GAAP may be used for internal and non-public reporting purposes. The International Company is required to keep accounting records that are sufficient to explain transactions and reflect financial position with reasonable accuracy.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The company must deliver to its licensed registered agent a written confirmation of its registered shareholders and ultimate beneficial owners on each annual renewal date. The registered agent maintains a private beneficial ownership register and makes it available to SIFA upon lawful request. Any share transfer, allotment, or change of beneficial ownership occurring during the year must be communicated to the registered agent promptly and before the next annual confirmation; no public UBO filing is made in Samoa.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,000 - USD 2,500 per annum for a licensed Samoa registered agent and registered office service
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not normally required; voluntary certified IFRS audit USD 8,000 - USD 15,000 per engagement

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (International Company statutory exemption; domestic resident corporate rate is 27%)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: International Companies registered under the International Companies Act 1987 are exempt from Samoa income tax, capital gains tax, dividend withholding tax, stamp duty and most transaction taxes. A flat annual government fee applies in place of tax on profits.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return is required for an International Company. Annual registry compliance is effected through the Annual Return Form IC-AR filed with the Samoa International Companies Registry (SICR) using the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) online portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 60 days after the anniversary of the company's incorporation date, unless an extension is granted by the Registry.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered legal name, company number, date of incorporation and jurisdiction of incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the exact legal name as shown in the Certificate of Incorporation; foreign registrations must not be mingled with the Samoa IC registration number.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: The registered office address in Samoa, including the name of the licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The address must be a physical Samoa registered-agent service address; a post-office box alone is not accepted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered agent or Samoan professional representative responsible for statutory communications.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide the registered agent's licence number and contact details; non-resident directors may use the agent as service address.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 4 - Declaration of exempt offshore status
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statement confirming that no business is conducted within Samoa and that the company remains an international-company tax exemption.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident equity holders must ensure the statement accurately reflects the company's actual commercial activity; loss of exemption triggers Samoan income tax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation of payment of the statutory annual fee and any applicable late penalty.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payment must be made by the registered agent in Samoa from the client's funds; no tax return or financial statements are required for exempt ICs.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing causes monetary penalty assessments by the Registry (generally WST 100 per month or part thereof), suspension of the certificate of good standing, and potential strike-off and deregistration if arrears remain unpaid for a statutory period.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% for an exempt International Company; a dividend paid by an IC derives no taxable income in Samoa and is free of dividend withholding tax.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable in the usual case because no Samoan withholding tax arises. Where a treaty may be invoked, a non-resident shareholder claiming treaty relief must obtain a Samoa Tax Residence Certificate from the Samoa Department of Inland Revenue and submit the claim together with the transacting entity's exemption evidence and the treaty article map.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Under general Samoa domestic law non-resident interest is subject to 10% withholding (bank/reinsurance exceptions apply); the general royalty withholding rate is 10%. An exempt International Company paying royalties or interest outside Samoa is not subject to Samoa WHT unless the payment is sourced from Samoan-taxable trade.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No mandatory local-file or master-file threshold applies to a tax-exempt International Company. For resident companies subject to Samoa income tax, contemporaneous transfer-pricing documentation is expected for controlled transactions exceeding WST 500,000 in aggregate value; OECD TP principles are persuasive under Samoa general anti-avoidance rules.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: An International Company must maintain its character as an offshore investment holding vehicle: it cannot carry on business in Samoa and must preserve a registered agent, minutes of meetings and registers. Samoa applies the OECD/Global Forum economic-substance expectations to offshore entities; a pure equity-holding PE SPV is generally not subject to separate Economic Substance Regulations filing in Samoa if it has no Samoan source income. However, if the SPV is deemed managed and controlled in Samoa, the claim of non-residence could be challenged and tax exemption revoked.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: An International Company carrying on trade in Samoa or deriving Samoan-source income while declaring itself fully exempt; submitting a false annual exemption declaration to the Registry; or failing to notify the Samoa tax authority that exemption status has been lost.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Back-assessment at the 27% corporate rate, penalty up to 150% of the undercharged tax, default interest, and criminal prosecution; statutory fines plus imprisonment up to 7 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly sign false declarations are jointly and severally liable for the unpaid tax and penalty; personal civil restitution orders, travel restrictions, and imprisonment can be imposed.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the PE SPV as a façade to conceal beneficial ownership, engage in circular self-lending, or hold assets with no economic decision-making or record-keeping; tolerating the company being struck off while continuing to transact.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the International Companies Act, the Court may declare the company defunct, order deregistration and strike-off, forfeit its assets, and impose monetary penalties on the company and those in control.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Piercing of the corporate veil leads to director and shareholder personal liability for third-party debts and tort claims; disqualification from acting as a director and loss of capacity to hold a Samoan registered agent licence.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to maintain beneficial ownership records, refusing to respond to a Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit summons, or executing syndicated wire transfers without a suspicious-transaction report where red flags exist.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Non-compliance with Samoa AML/CFT laws attracts fines of up to WST 1,000,000, freezing and forfeiture orders, and imprisonment of responsible officers for up to 14 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers can be arrested, prevented from leaving Samoa, and held liable for civil restitution to victims; corporate veil protection is expressly lifted for money-laundering offences.
